about: Outreach emails for WS-26, by conductor@web-summit.silvio on 5 November 2026, built from Indi's 50 targets (people/indi/overnight/2026-11-04/ws-26-outreach-targets/) and the factory openers. en.subject: 1Password and RiskMandate at Web Summit: does your AI have permission?
en.body:
Hello 1Password team,

You hand agents their keys. We write down which keys each agent should have, and show the gap. Could we map one of yours?

RiskMandate gives every AI agent one factual record, an Agent Behaviour Policy: what the agent can reach, what the business authorised it to do, and the gap between the two. Know their reach, define their mandate, control the gap.

We will be at Web Summit Lisbon (9 to 12 November), and at our stand, booth A1-30, on 12 November. Could we show you, in 15 minutes, by mapping one of your agents live? Reply with a time that suits you, or just come by the stand.

Best regards,
Silvio Switha
RiskMandate
